0 / 留空 = 1；各家上限不同（1-4 / 1-6），超了由上游报错: 0 / empty = 1; the limit varies by vendor (1-4 / 1-6) — the upstream API errors if exceeded
0 / 留空 = 默认；不支持的家忽略: 0 / empty = default; ignored by vendors that don't support it
0 / 留空 = 默认；不支持的家忽略，实际采样率看出参: 0 / empty = default; ignored by vendors that don't support it — check the output field for the actual sample rate used
0 = 没走到 HTTP（网络不通 / 地址解析失败）: 0 = the request never reached HTTP (network unreachable / DNS resolution failed)
1:1 / 16:9 / 9:16 / 4:3 / 3:4；留空 = 默认；给了: 1:1 / 16:9 / 9:16 / 4:3 / 3:4; empty = default; ignored when a size is given
Form=inline 时是 data URL；Form=uri 时是地址: A data URL when Form=inline; a URL when Form=uri
GPT 系列大模型接入（OpenAI 兼容协议）。: Integrates the GPT model family (OpenAI-compatible protocol).
Matryoshka 截断：想要几维（0/留空=模型默认）。1024 维的存储只: Matryoshka truncation: the number of dimensions you want (0/empty = the model's default). Storing 1024 dimensions costs a third of 3072, with little quality loss. Ignored by vendors that don't support it — check the output field dims for the actual dimensionality used
WxH 像素，如 1024x1024；留空 = 默认。各家只认固定几档: WxH in pixels, e.g. 1024x1024; empty = default. Each vendor only recognizes a fixed set of sizes
audio_seconds（音频秒数）/ token 各家能给几项给几项: audio_seconds / tokens: each vendor reports whichever of these it can
characters（字符）/ token 各家能给几项给几项，平台按部署的计价: characters / tokens: each vendor reports whichever of these it can; the platform reads whichever matches the deployment's billing unit
images（生成的图片张数），平台按部署的计价单位取: images (number of images generated); the platform reads this for deployments billed by image
inline data URL（平台把字节交给实现）: An inline data URL (the platform hands the bytes to the implementation)
inline data URL；MIME 与容器一致（audio/mpeg /: An inline data URL; MIME matches the container (audio/mpeg / audio/wav)
inline=data URL；uri=上游给的地址: inline=data URL; uri=a URL given by upstream
inline=平台传字节（data URL）；uri=只给地址，模型自己去取: inline=the platform sends the bytes (data URL); uri=only a URL is given, and the model fetches it itself
len == len(texts) * dims；第 i 条 = flat[i*: len == len(texts) * dims; item i is flat[i*dims:(i+1)*dims], in the same order as texts
mp3 / wav / pcm16；留空 = mp3。pcm16 由实现裹成 W: mp3 / wav / pcm16; empty = mp3. For pcm16, the implementation wraps it as WAV before returning it
normalized_01 = 分数在 [0,1]，可直接与阈值比；unboun: normalized_01 = the score is in [0,1] and can be compared directly to a threshold; unbounded = a raw logit, positive or negative, usable only for ranking; empty = the endpoint didn't say, unknown
query + 候选文本 → 相关度分数（与输入等长同序）: query + candidate texts → relevance scores (same length and order as the input)
一批文本 → 一批向量（与输入等长同序）: A batch of texts → a batch of vectors (same length and order as the input)
上游改写 / 扩写过提示词时给出；空 = 按请求: Given when upstream has rewritten or expanded the prompt; empty = used the prompt as requested
上游改写过请求文本时（润色 / 自动生成播报稿）给出；空 = 念的就是请求文本: Given when upstream has rewritten the requested text (polishing / auto-generating a script); empty = the text spoken is exactly the requested text
不可用时是原因与下一步；**base_url 填错通常表现为 404 而不是 4: When unavailable, explains why and what to do next; **a wrong base_url usually shows up as a 404, not a 401** — the message distinguishes between the two
不希望出现的内容；不支持的家忽略: Content you don't want to appear; ignored by vendors that don't support it
与 texts 等长同序: Same length and order as texts
与上游返回同集；顺序按 id 稳定排序: The same set as upstream returns; sorted stably by id
函数参数的形状由调用方定义，是任意 JSON Schema: The shape of the function's arguments is defined by the caller, as an arbitrary JSON Schema
厂商专属参数，形状由上游 API 决定: Vendor-specific parameters, shaped by the upstream API
厂商专属参数，形状由上游 API 决定；已有键不覆盖，对象键下钻一层合并: Vendor-specific parameters, shaped by the upstream API; existing keys are not overwritten — objects are merged one level deep by key
厂商私有,平台与别家都不解释: Vendor-private; neither the platform nor other vendors interpret it
参数形状由该函数的 JSON Schema 决定，运行期才知道: The shape of the arguments is determined by this function's JSON Schema, known only at runtime
各家自己的音色 id；留空 = 这家的默认音色: The vendor's own voice id; empty = that vendor's default voice
同 chat，但边生成边产出增量: Same as chat, but streams incremental output as it generates
图生图 / 编辑的参考图（inline data URL，1-3 张）；留空 =: Reference image(s) for image-to-image / editing (inline data URL, 1-3 images); empty = text-to-image
实现**真正**施加了哪个口径；空 = 没施加（这家没这个概念，或这个模型不支持: Which convention the implementation actually applied; empty = none applied (this vendor has no such concept, or the model doesn't support it)
已落平台文件层（png / jpeg / webp），可直接传给下游节点或内联显: Already stored in the platform file layer (png / jpeg / webp); can be passed directly to downstream nodes or displayed inline
平台据此判断能力降级与 failover: The platform uses this to decide on capability downgrades and failover
平台的 canonical 请求（模型名已解析为上游真名）: The platform's canonical request (the model name has already been resolved to its real upstream name)
形状由该函数的 JSON Schema 决定，运行期才知道: Its shape is determined by this function's JSON Schema, known only at runtime
拿这条凭证问一次上游「有哪些模型」，给部署编辑的模型名下拉用: Uses this credential to ask upstream once for its model list, for the model-name dropdown in the deployment editor
拿这条凭证问一次上游的模型列表，验证 key 与 base_url 都对: Uses this credential to fetch upstream's model list once, verifying that both the key and base_url are correct
按 canonical 请求调用上游模型，返回完整回答: Calls the upstream model with the canonical request and returns the full response
文本 / 参考图 → 图片文件（已落平台文件层）: Text / reference image → image file (already stored in the platform file layer)
某语音合成模型可选的预置音色；custom=true 表示可 / 需自由填写（音: A preset voice offered by some text-to-speech models; custom=true means free text is allowed/required (voice cloning, voice design, compatibility gateways)
模型产出的图 / 音频等（inline=data URL，uri=地址）；只在请: Images/audio etc. produced by the model (inline=data URL, uri=a URL); present only when the corresponding output modality was requested
由平台路由填入: Filled in by the platform router
由平台路由填入；TEI 那类一进程一模型的实现会忽略它: Filled in by the platform router; ignored by one-process-one-model implementations like TEI
由调用方给出，形状随其业务而定: Given by the caller; its shape depends on the caller's own use case
结构化输出的结果，形状由调用方给的 JSON Schema 决定: The structured output result; its shape is determined by the JSON Schema the caller provided
给识别器的上下文 / 专有名词；不支持的家忽略: Context / proper nouns for the recognizer; ignored by vendors that don't support it
自然语言的语气 / 情绪 / 角色描述，不会被念出来；不支持的家忽略: A natural-language description of tone / emotion / character, which is not spoken aloud; ignored by vendors that don't support it
要念的文本；风格标签（如 (开心) / [笑]）算文本的一部分，原样透传: The text to speak; style tags (such as (happy) / [laughs]) are treated as part of the text and passed through verbatim
要生成的画面；带参考图时是编辑指令: The image to generate; when a reference image is given, this is an editing instruction
识别出的语种；空 = 上游没说: The detected language; empty = not reported by upstream
请求的推理语义被就近执行时的一句提示（如 GLM-5.3 家族关不掉思考）；空: A note for when the requested reasoning semantics were approximated (e.g. the GLM-5.3 family can't turn off thinking); empty = executed faithfully
这批文本要拿来干什么：retrieval_document（被检索的一方）/ r: What this batch of texts is for: retrieval_document (the side being retrieved) / retrieval_query (the side issuing the retrieval) / similarity / classification; empty = unspecified. Retrieval models treat queries and documents differently — getting this wrong won't error, but recall will suffer
部署级透传给上游的额外 body 字段，形状由上游 API 决定: Extra body fields passed through to upstream at the deployment level, shaped by the upstream API
音色复刻的样本音频（inline data URL）；只有支持复刻的模型认它: Sample audio for voice cloning (inline data URL); recognized only by models that support cloning
